name: Vajszló (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Vajszló (a white and green shield with a red rosette) within a wreath of oak, above a yellow scroll inscribed VAJSZLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vajszló arms with wreath and scroll
